ci_investigation.symptom: hosted CI red for five consecutive runs (27..33) on BOTH ubuntu and windows, while the maker's Windows suite was green
ci_investigation.root_cause: the CI workflow installs pytest and nothing else, so the `build` package is absent on the runner. build() resolved a backend interpreter inline, so the sdist-normalisation test -- which stubs the build COMMAND -- still needed a real backend and raised SystemExit. An environment gap was reported as a product failure, and because the mutation probe requires the unmutated tree to pass, the whole probe went red with it.
ci_investigation.how_found: reproduced locally by building a CI-equivalent environment (git on PATH, no build backend); the failure reappeared exactly and vanished when the backend was reachable
fixes: build() takes the builder interpreter as an argument and resolves it only when the caller did not supply one
_has_build() no longer raises on a candidate interpreter that does not exist
the D1 repair's skip markers now match the wording the builder actually prints
the write-through invariant test skips when git is absent instead of raising
a new regression test pins that the stubbed build path never consults the resolver
